nodes.name: DynamoDB - Get Member Profile
nodes.notes: Native AWS DynamoDB node. Returns tier, threshold, tenure_years, specialist_email, member_email, member_notification_topic_arn for the member. Key condition: member_id partition key from the webhook body.

nodes.name: DynamoDB - Get Point Ledger Transactions
nodes.notes: Native AWS DynamoDB node, Get All Items. Queries every transaction (earn/redeem/adjustment/dispute) for this member from the PointLedgerTransactions table -- this is now the single source of truth for points, not the webhook payload.

options.systemMessage:
You are a Tier Eligibility Agent for a loyalty program. Given member JSON with current_points, threshold, open_disputes, dispute_amount, tenure_years, and tier (all sourced from the Point Ledger and Members tables, not the caller), compute: percent_below_threshold, has_open_disputes, is_platinum, tenure_waiver_eligible, a confidence_score (0-100) that an automated downgrade is correct, is_borderline (true if percent_below_threshold<5 OR has_open_disputes OR is_platinum OR tenure_waiver_eligible), and meets_auto_resolve (true if percent_below_threshold>15 AND not has_open_disputes AND confidence_score>=80). Respond with ONLY a raw JSON object containing exactly these fields, no prose, no markdown code fences.

Expected Output: A raw JSON judgement object in $json.output.

nodes.name: AI Agent - Tier Eligibility Agent
nodes.notes: Built-in LangChain Agent node -- ships with n8n, nothing to install. Requires a connected chat model (AWS Bedrock Chat Model below) via the model input on the canvas; memory is optional and connected the same way. Output lands in $json.output as plain text.

nodes.name: Window Buffer Memory (per member)
nodes.notes: Optional but recommended: gives the agent short-term memory of this member's recent review history within a session key scoped to member_id. This is in-memory per n8n instance, not a durable cross-session store like AgentCore's managed memory -- for durable history, rely on the Point Ledger audit entries instead.

nodes.name: DynamoDB - Update Tier Status (Honour)
nodes.notes: autoParseNumbers disabled: with it on, an empty-string field value is sent as an empty Number attribute and DynamoDB rejects the PutItem with "The parameter cannot be converted to a numeric value". reason falls back to a non-empty string when the specialist leaves notes blank.

nodes.name: CloudWatch - SLA Breach Alarm
nodes.notes: No native CloudWatch node exists in n8n as of this version, so this stays an HTTP Request node with AWS SigV4 auth (Predefined Credential Type: AWS). URL is the CloudWatch Query API endpoint for ap-south-1 (monitoring.<region>.amazonaws.com), NOT the console UI URL -- the console URL returns an HTML "Page not found" page. Query API params go in the form-urlencoded POST body, which is what SigV4 expects for signed POSTs.
